decision.structure: Windows command construction quotes every argv entry, retains a distinct unquoted application path, and passes the owned child handle through the canonical Child value/drop contract. UTF16 allocation length is widened before multiplying by two.
decision.branches: Empty, space, quote and trailing-backslash arguments; first argument versus later arguments; conversion/quotation allocation failures; failed spawn versus success; explicit wait/move versus abandoned Child.
decision.logic: The raw application pointer survives until CreateProcessW returns and is freed separately from all quoted argv entries. Current CSharp and SLG both widen chars+null to i64 before UTF16 allocation. Child cleanup follows the owned type and releases its native token once.
